steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: Death... awaits... at the end...

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: My liege... watches... death, watches... you...

steps.name: Excited Soldier
steps.text: Captain, the target has been neutralized! But our remaining ammunition is estimated to last only two more minutes!

steps.name: Excited Soldier
steps.text: We need our next set of orders!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: All units, prepare for close-quarter combat!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Hold the line for the next two minutes—I'll cover your retreat!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Siege, our artillery support is running out!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The bombardment will end in three minutes! What's the situation on your side?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We can't clear this Nachzehrer fog!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: These things have severed the supply routes our workers cleared for us. We can't get supplies to your position quickly enough.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Prepare to retreat from T1.

steps.name: Excited Soldier
steps.text: Negative! Abandoning T1 will create a gap in our encirclement, and the alliance forces will break through from our side! Captain, I can't accept that—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The battlefield isn't a place for heroics! Honor your orders!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: We've sent a distress signal to our friends at Rhodes Island. Now we have to trust the Doctor and the plan.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Soldiers, we've made it home. Do everything you can to survive! Only then can we take back what we've lost!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Siege, we'll hold the line for the final two minutes, then retreat to regroup and assist you in clearing out the creatures in the fog!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, keep them safe!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye, Captain!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: If the fog can't be dispersed, don't wait for us. Head to I12 and rendezvous with Gododdin's 106th Assault Brigade. Keep fighting.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'll be seein' ye soon, Captain—

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: (Strange howl)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Look out, Siege!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It's the Confessarius chimeras! Everyone, prepare to retreat!

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: (Song-like shriek)

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: It's lit itself up! Hannah, watch out for its flames!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oof... It hurts... Vina, are you alright?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Everyone else, fall back! I can't allow any more needless sacrifices...

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: (A piercing wail)

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Wait—where did this backup come from!?

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Anti-witchcraft cannon has struck the target. Enemy movement disrupted. Remaining squads, continue setting up anti-witchcraft cannons.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Mission objective: eliminate threats within the fog.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Friendly forces at T1, hold your position. Emergency supplies will arrive at your location in three and a half minutes.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Exemplar T1 Combat Team—message received! Please identify your unit!

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Duke of Normandy's 8th Grenadier Battalion, under orders to support The Exemplars.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: The Duke of Normandy? 8th Grenadier Battalion? Horn, do you know anything about this unit?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: They're not under the direct command of the Duke of Normandy. They report to the Earl of March.

steps.name: The Young Duke
steps.text: Lieutenant Skamandros truly has an exceptional grasp of our intelligence operations, as to be expected from someone born into a military family.

steps.name: The Young Duke
steps.text: Lieutenant, keep Her Royal Highness Alexandrina safe.

steps.name: The Young Duke
steps.text: As for Your Highness, please accept this small gift.

steps.name: The Young Duke
steps.text: Once all these matters are resolved, I'll visit you in person, Vina.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Siege, do you know the Earl of March?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: No, we've never met. But her name was mentioned in some of the information sent to me.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: That doesn't matter now. With reinforcements, we should be able to reopen the supply line. Horn, we'll meet again soon!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: At last, it's time to bring all of this to an end.

steps.name: Excited Soldier
steps.text: Finally!
The crowd cheers.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Phew—
She gazes at The Shard in the distance and the faintly visible Palace of Westhaleg, calmer than she has ever been.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Triangle, Cello, Oboe... Tempest Platoon, everyone, watch closely.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...As we scatter the dark clouds over Londinium!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: All members of the Exemplar T1 Combat Team, hear this: hold your ground. Do not give them a single inch!
'Roger that!'

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain, Rock-18 just uploaded the scan of the last segment of our route to PRTS. Did you receive it?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Got it! Rockrock, we're already repairing the final track-shift node.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Given the current damage level, how long until the repairs are complete?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ten minutes.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Located Granny yet? We need to retrieve that weapon as soon as possible. The Exemplars will need our support on the front line.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Still trying to pinpoint the correct location.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The signals we've found over the past few days were all decoy beacons they left behind. It might take a bit more time to re-establish contact.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: At least that means Granny's team is still safe for now...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain, if—and I mean if—we can't get in touch with Catherine, what should we do?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We'll use this passage to transport as much of Highbury's remaining supplies as possible to—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain?!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *cough*—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *cough* Is everyone okay?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Where did those Sarkaz come from... and what was that artillery fire I just heard?
The smoke shifts, yet a small ember glimmers brightly in the depths of the haze...
The ember of a cigarette.
A familiar, acrid smell hits Feist's nose and makes his eyes sting.
I keep telling you, when you're busy working, you always forget to watch your back.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Welcome home, brat.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny! We've been looking for you all this time!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I know. When someone told me the passage was being repaired, I figured it was you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That's—
He spots a massive shadow in the depths of the smoke.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Haha, remember the blueprints you left behind?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: It took some effort, with the Sarkaz blockade and all, but we finally managed to build your big machine.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Crawler...

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: I know you're there.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Your earring has grown... rather warm.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Those workers who came to support the Self-Salvation Corps earlier—that was your doing, wasn't it?

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Shh, you'll disturb my friends.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Still, thank you for taking good care of Little Garnet for me, kitten.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: And thank you for cleaning up those filthy rocks Duq'arael left behind.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Here. You can have this back.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: I have more important things to deal with.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Off to find that hunk of sheetmetal again?

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: He… wouldn't want to miss this battle.

steps.name: Millscar
steps.text: Thank you for saving me earlier. Farewell.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Where are you off to next?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: To meet with him.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: You're not going to go help Dame Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: With Amiya and Logos there, nothing will happen.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I'll wait for them beneath the Palace of Westhaleg. It's his last known location, as far as I know.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Her Highness is gone. It's time to put the past to rest.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Your wounds...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Insignificant.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You don't need to involve yourself in the frontline work anymore. Take care of yourself.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Don't you understand how powerful I am by now, runt? You learned quite a bit from us back in the day, didn't you?

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Bringing you into the city was the most I could do. Whatever is between you and the Regent—Rose Riverside will no longer be involved.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Where will you go next?

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: I'll keep tracking her down. She disappeared so suddenly, abandoning Her Highness at the most critical moment. That demands an explanation.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: One of our sharp-eyed sisters managed to track her as she left Londinium. She's still heading west, though her destination is unclear.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: And when you catch her? Will you bring her back, or kill her?

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: She owes all the Riverbank Canoes an explanation.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: But you, runt, should worry about yourself first. The Regent is close at hand.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: The Riverside Canoes swore not to get involved with anything related to Babel anymore. However, helping an old acquaintance doesn't break the rules.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: This smear of blood—it's a gift and a blessing, for less pain and fewer scars. Safe travels, Ascalon.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Did you really have to wipe it on my neck?

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Not my fault you always hide your face so well under that hood. You look better this way.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Mysterious Vampire
steps.text: Oh, by the way, I forgot to ask—what do you think of that kitten?
She does not emerge from the shadows, and the wind carries her voice.
'My judgment is unnecessary. When the dust settles, the truth will reveal itself.'
'We're all the same.'

a.text: Even today, many still argue about when exactly the war ended.

spans.text: Even today, many still argue about when exactly the war ended.

a.text: Some say it was when the Nachzehrer King fell at the gates of the Palace of Westhaleg. Others say it was when the Sarkaz fully withdrew from Londinium.

spans.text: Some say it was when the Nachzehrer King fell at the gates of the Palace of Westhaleg. Others say it was when the Sarkaz fully withdrew from Londinium.

a.text: As someone who lived through it, I've been asked quite frequently about my opinion.

spans.text: As someone who lived through it, I've been asked quite frequently about my opinion.

a.text: Luckily, I share the exact same view as Vina:

spans.text: Luckily, I share the exact same view as Vina:

a.text: The war ended the moment we found the courage to take the sword from Vina's hands and wield it against the Nachzehrer King ourselves.

spans.text: The war ended the moment we found the courage to take the sword from Vina's hands and wield it against the Nachzehrer King ourselves.

a.text: We fought back. We destroyed, with our own hands, the enemies who tried to ruin us. We never needed a singular hero.

spans.text: We fought back. We destroyed, with our own hands, the enemies who tried to ruin us. We never needed a singular hero.

a.text: That day, everyone who fought for her home and her future was a hero.

spans.text: That day, everyone who fought for her home and her future was a hero.

steps.text: 'Everyone, no matter your unit number, which squad you belong to, or which duke you serve—'
'There's no retreating now!'
'Support the allied forces! Why should we lag behind this lot?'
'Quick, go help The Exemplars!'
'Captain, argh—my weapon's broken—'
'Take mine! If it breaks, grab another! If there's none left, snatch a blade from the devils and keep fighting!'
'Advance! Advance!!'
'For Victoria!'
'For Victoria!'

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Soldier, you should not continue this assault empty-handed.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Take this sword.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ...but, this is the Sighs of Kings... I can't possibly...

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: It belongs to Your Royal Highness.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: No. It belongs to Victoria.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: On the wreckage of the Glorious, trusted allies passed the sword from hand to hand until it reached me, completing its mission.

spans.text: On the wreckage of the
Glorious,
trusted allies passed the sword from hand to hand until it reached me, completing its mission.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Now, take it from my hand! Let it reach the hands of everyone who needs it. Let its mission continue anew.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: This is your right as a Victorian.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: But if we take the sword, what will Your Royal Highness use?

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I still have my hammer.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I will not stop. I will stay with you until the end.
The early morning sun breaks through the dark clouds. A golden-haired Feline and a Victorian stand together.
The soldier grips the sword tightly, her gaze locked on the determined Aslan, despite the blinding sunlight.
She refuses to look away, for she sees the thousands of Victorians rallied behind her, fighting for the same cause.
She sees the King, walking alongside her people.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: As you bid.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: All survivors of the 6th Column, 10th Infantry Regiment, advance with me!

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: For Victoria!

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ♪May the vast lands they keep owre kynge.
She cuts down two Nachzehrer Royal Court elites and a caster. Her blade bears two new notches.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ♪His people, and alle his well-wyllynge,
However, she is too gravely injured to continue, so she passes the sword on.
A worker grips the sword and presses forward. He perishes alongside a Royal Court elite, leaving yet another notch on the blade.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ♪And give them grace wythoute endyng!
An Infected picks the sword up from the pool of blood. She does not defeat any enemies, instead protecting it with her body.
In so doing, she protects her Victoria and hope itself.

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ♪Then may we call and savely syng,

steps.name: Diane Weber
steps.text: ♪Victoria, yeve thankes for owre hom!

a.text: Finally, the sword pierced the Nachzehrer King, after which it disappeared into the chaos of the battle.

spans.text: Finally, the sword pierced the Nachzehrer King, after which it disappeared into the chaos of the battle.

a.text: To this day, we still don't know who the final hero to wield the sword was, or whether they're still alive. But one thing is certain—the sword fulfilled its mission.

spans.text: To this day, we still don't know who the final hero to wield the sword was, or whether they're still alive. But one thing is certain—the sword fulfilled its mission.

a.text: The Victorians wielded the blade against the invaders.

spans.text: The Victorians wielded the blade against the invaders.

a.text: But its legend didn't end there. They say it was the workers who recovered the broken Sighs of Kings from the blood and mud.

spans.text: But its legend didn't end there. They say it was the workers who recovered the broken Sighs of Kings from the blood and mud.

a.text: As for the rest of the story, well, every child in Londinium can sing it loud and clear.

spans.text: As for the rest of the story, well, every child in Londinium can sing it loud and clear.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I don't see any more Nachzehrers. Is the battle finally over?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But this blasted fog hasn't let up one bit.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Something's not right. The Sarkaz aren't attacking under the cover of the thick fog like before. Is this a trap?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Based on our previous encounters with the Nachzehrer army, they are far more elusive than they seem.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Horn, what do you suppose we should do next?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Coordinate with the main allied forces, hold off on advancing rashly, and minimize unnecessary casualties until we get a clearer read on the situation.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Alright. Sound strategy.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Dagda, send the orders to all of our troops.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'll pass it on to the alliance commanders, as well as Closure and the others.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Hey, heyyy, hey! Did Hood even get the frequency right?

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Huh? We're already live?

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Gah! Everybody, listen up! Babel's captured the Military Commission's Command Center.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: The bastards don't know their heads from their asses right now, and nobody's got it in them to help out the crusty old Nachzehrer King.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: So quit wasting time and get those feet moving!

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: I don't care if you believe me or not, just go and get this over with!

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: Oh, and by the way, you might wanna look up.

steps.name: Unknown Transmission
steps.text: The old hag owes me big this time.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Delphine—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: We traced the transmission. It seems this communication was received on several different frequencies.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Both the allies and the Sarkaz probably heard it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That voice... it was....

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Wiš'adel. Sounds like they've been busy.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Horn, please re-assess the situation.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, look at the sky! It's...
All eyes turn upwards, and soon they hear the sound of steam bursting at full force, echoing above the Palace of Westhaleg.
'Victoria!'
The Victorian army boils.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It's Charles Lynch! He's gone into the fog!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I can hear the commotion inside the clouds. He's battling the Nachzehrers.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Horn?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Although morale is currently high, the alliance has yet to make any major moves. Clearly, the dukes are still hesitating—they have reason to be cautious with intelligence from an unknown source.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: If Rhodes Island trusts Wiš'adel, then so do I.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ha. We trust you as well, Siege. I'll go tell everyone to get ready.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Huh? What's going on?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Did you hear that sound... right beneath our feet!
The Exemplars, we meet at last.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Wait a minute, Vina. Am I seeing things, or did a giant... thing just burrow out from underground?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: A giant thing? No. It has a name.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The Crawler. My grandson designed it. Pretty good, huh?
The gray-haired pilot blows a smoke ring, standing proudly on the ladder of the massive machine.
It has four massive steam-powered hydraulic legs, encased in protective armor that bears the unmistakable signs of a worker's handiwork.
Smoke is still billowing from its enormous, black cannon barrel, a clear sign that it was the one responsible for the massive hole in the ground.
A steady stream of Self-Salvation Corps members emerge from the gaping hole beneath The Crawler, carrying combat supplies up to the surface.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Siege, thank goodness we made it here in time!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Starting now, the Self-Salvation Corps will join forces with you. With Granny and her team helping out, we'll have a much greater chance of victory!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We just got that message ourselves—it seems the timing is spot on.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: I-Victoria thanks you!

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Horn?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: All clear. The preparations are complete, and we're ready to move out at any time.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Everyone, this is the final battle. We—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Wait a minute. There's still one thing left.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I need to adjust the cannon.... there. That should do it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Cover your ears!
The cannon strikes the giant bell at the center of Auchterigg, an ancient relic that had stood for centuries.
The bell tolls, loud, clear, and beautiful, followed by the sound of the alliance war horns and their furious battle cries.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We've got to let certain people know we're here.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're in command now.

steps.name: Vina
steps.text: Victorians! Charge forth to our final victory!
